description: Use verb-noun format consistently for all story elements (epics, features, stories, scenarios). Maintain consistency across hierarchy levels.

examples.description: Use verb-noun format at all levels
content: Story: User places order, System validates payment
Scenario: When user submits form, then system processes request

examples.description: Use base verb forms (infinitive/imperative), not gerunds or third-person singular
content: Correct: Select Tokens, Group Minions, Add To Mob
Wrong: Selects Tokens (3rd person), Selecting Tokens (gerund), Grouping Minions (gerund)
Epic: Manage Orders → Feature: Place Order → Story: Customer places order

examples.description: Don't use noun-only or capability-based names
content: Order Management, Payment Processing, Character System

examples.description: Don't mix formats between hierarchy levels
content: Epic: Order Management → Feature: Place Order (inconsistent)
